Name: The Shunammite Woman
Summary: The Shunammite woman was a hospitable woman who built a room for Elisha and was blessed with a son. When the boy died, she clung to God in famous faith, declaring, It is well.
KeyStory: She laid her dead son on Elisha's bed, rode to the prophet, and refused to leave him until he came and raised the boy to life.
LifeLesson: Her 'it is well' was spoken while her son lay lifeless — faith anchored in God, not circumstances. That same anchor can hold your soul in the storm.
